title: acetosella haenkeana
intro: Acetosella haenkeana, commonly known as mountain sorrel, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Oxalidaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as treating kidney stones, reducing inflammation, and aiding in the treatment of various digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Acetosella haenkeana include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Acetosella haenkeana include oxalic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
